name: case_draft
input:
Draft exactly 1 test case.
REQUIREMENT:
Guest can submit checkout.
APPROVED_COVERAGE_MAP:
1. Submit checkout with all mandatory fields valid; verify successful submission.

name: checklist
input:
Draft exactly 3 test cases.
REQUIREMENT:
A guest can submit checkout when all mandatory fields are valid.
APPROVED_COVERAGE_MAP:
1. Submit with every mandatory field valid; verify success.
2. Submit with one mandatory field empty; verify validation prevents submission.
3. Correct the invalid field and resubmit; verify success.

name: duplicate_case
input:
Draft exactly 2 test cases.
REQUIREMENT:
Checkout accepts a saved card and a new valid card.
APPROVED_COVERAGE_MAP:
1. Pay with a saved valid card; verify successful checkout.
2. Pay with a newly entered valid card; verify successful checkout.

name: negative_cases
input:
Draft exactly 2 test cases.
REQUIREMENT:
An empty checkout form shows validation for every mandatory field.
APPROVED_COVERAGE_MAP:
1. Submit an entirely empty form; verify every mandatory field is marked invalid.
2. Fill only one mandatory field and submit; verify validation remains on every other mandatory field.
